profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer, Data at SoFi
profile.summary:
I am currently working as a Staff Software Engineer, Data at SoFi, where I lead the development and maintenance of our AWS and Snowflake cloud infrastructure for our data platform. With a degree in Computer Information Systems from Carroll College and certifications in Leadership, Geographic Information Systems, and Project Management with an Agile framework, I've built a strong foundation in both technical and leadership skills.

My career journey has been driven by a passion for data infrastructure and a commitment to continuous learning. I'm skilled in a range of technologies, including AWS, Docker, Kafka, Python, ANSI SQL, and Terraform, and I'm always seeking to enhance my skills to stay at the forefront of industry trends.

I'm grateful for the opportunities I've had to grow and contribute to impactful projects, and I'm excited to continue driving innovation and excellence in my current role at SoFi.

Proficient in: AWS, Bitbucket, AWS Cloud Formation, Docker, Git, Gitlab, AWS Glue, JavaScript, JIRA, Kafka, Linux, Microsoft Office, MySQL, PL/pgSQL, PostgreSQL, Python, Glue Spark, Spark, SQL, SNOWSQL, Terraform


Experienced in:

- 5 years of experience in building and maintaining SoFi's self-service data platform, leveraging AWS and Snowflake cloud infrastructure.
- 4 years of experience in building Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using AWS Cloud Formation and Terraform to ensure efficient and scalable deployments.
- 8 years of experience in object-oriented programming with a focus on data pipelining in Python, driving the development of robust and efficient data solutions.
- 6 years of experience in ETL maintenance support for Data Warehouse, ensuring data accuracy and availability for business insights.
- 4 years of experience in developing self-healing data pipelines to reduce developer touch points for on-call support, enhancing system reliability and operational efficiency.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer, Data
positions.description:
• Lead the design, development, and maintenance of a scalable AWS and Snowflake cloud infrastructure to support SoFi's data platform, utilizing Terraform Cloud for efficient Infrastructure as Code (IaC) deployments.
• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineering teams, fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
• Spearhead the investigation and integration of cutting-edge technologies, patterns, and practices to enhance our data capabilities, with a focus on using Python for the development of solutions to assist in data pipeline development.
• Represent the engineering team in cross-functional collaborations, ensuring alignment with business objectives and stakeholder requirements.
• Work closely with product and business managers to define strategic goals, measure KPIs, and leverage data-driven insights to drive informed decisions.
• Continuously evaluate and refine our data models and services, identifying opportunities for optimization and innovation.
• Implement and oversee a comprehensive metadata tool for the company and its affiliated companies, driving the adoption of data governance standards and ensuring data quality and consistency.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Big Data Infrastructure
positions.description:
• Develop and maintain an AWS and Snowflake cloud infrastructure to support SoFi's data platform
• Provide technical leadership, mentorship, pairing opportunities, and code reviews
• Investigate and drive adoption of new technologies, patterns, and practices
• Collaborate and represent your engineering squad with outside stakeholders
• Work with amazing product and business managers to identify strategic opportunities, set and measure KPIs, make data-driven recommendations, and drive informed actions.
• Identify the improvements in our data models and services, functional gaps, and design and build the solutions

positions.title: Data Engineer - Big Data Infrastructure
positions.description:
Responsibilities 

• Develop and maintain an AWS cloud infrastructure to support an ETL service to bring in datasets from SoFi’s data ecosystem
• Utilize skills with AWS glue, python and spark to develop a self healing data pipeline for data ingestion.
• Process large amounts of structured and unstructured data, including integrating data from multiple sources.
• Support the infrastructure and products that the rest of the Data Engineering organization utilizes in day to day tasks (i.e. Data Warehouse, Self Service ETL tools, etc.)

positions.title: Data Engineer (ETL Developer)
positions.description:
Responsibilities:  
• Optimize data (both underlying data structure and delivery method) for use by reporting platforms
• Manage large databases within a micro service architecture  
• Learn and assist with our Extract Transform and Load (ETL) process for bringing data into the warehouse in order to turn it into usable information. 
• Partner with various stakeholders to build a strong data driven culture through the use of information based decision making. 
• Help these users access and understand the data and metrics in the data warehouse. 
• Developing appropriate new metrics to be used across the business. 
• Building ad hoc reports for various stakeholders. 
• Maintaining Documentation for the data pipeline

positions.title: Data Engineer (Data Quality)
positions.description:
Responsibilities: 
•      Find and investigate data issues in the data warehouse
•	Write SQL to validate quality of existing data
•	Build out automated checks for data quality
•	Troubleshoot data inconsistency issues
•	Contribute to the success of the data warehouse by improving the standards of data integrity
•	Write SQL scripts to clean existing data
•	Help data analytics team in their querying and understanding of the Data Warehouse
•	Write SQL and/or PL/SQL statements to produce reports for external investors
•	Interpret data, analyze results using statistical techniques and provide ongoing reports
•	Develop and implement databases, data collection systems, data analytics and other strategies that optimize statistical efficiency and quality
•	Acquire data from primary or secondary data sources and maintain databases/data systems
•	Identify, analyze, and interpret trends or patterns in complex data sets
•	Work with management to prioritize business and information needs
•	Locate and define new process improvement opportunities

positions.title: Solution Analyst/ Business Analyst
positions.description:
•	Responsible for design, development and management of high quality, efficient and effective solutions in SQL Server, Integration Services and related tools to support a number of large-scale data migration projects 
•	Work within a professional, dynamic and creative Agile development team to support delivery of a major change to an existing system that produces significant business benefits
•	Deliver a robust, testable, repeatable framework of jobs and scripts for migrating data and producing reconciliation reports to confirm success or failure
•	Identify and solve performance bottlenecks in SQL Server and Oracle database platforms

positions.title: Software Developer Internship
positions.description:
Department of Health and Human Services                                                                Helena, MT
Software Developer Intern: March 2016 to May 2016

•	Documented and demonstrated solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code using a REST methodology.
•	Utilized project planning and project management skills to develop and integrate an application into an environment with several other services.
•	Learned new languages to operate MyEclipse and build a RESTful web service running Tomcat, Maven, Spring, Hibernate, and JUNIT to create a standalone service for providing support to multiple services while increasing knowledge in Java, HTML, and XML

positions.description:
Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Montana 					     		Helena, MT

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description:
As a selling associate in either the apparel section or the footwear section I had two main tasks,  make sure all customers were being helped and to make sure our section was kept tidy and still easy to shop for the next customer. 

As a cashier I gained experience with handling money and making sure the customer moved through the line in a timely manner.  I also learned how to do returns and exchanges. 

As a stock associate I was in charge of processing new footwear and apparel that was shipped to the store.  I was in charge of doing transfers form other Puma stores and drop ship boxes from secondary Puma stores like Macy's.
